# ENUM\_ORDER\_DIRECTION variable

The `OrderDirection` values as an `@imqueue/rpc` type description.

**Signature:**

## Remarks

`'ASC' | 'DESC'`<!-- -->, built from the enum so the description cannot drift from it. Used in the `@indexed` description of [OrderByInput](/api/sequelize/latest/sequelize.orderbyinput/)<!-- -->, and available for your own `@property` declarations that accept a direction.
